title: Mara Cardenas
body: Transfer receipt due after gate access ends. Route: field office to window. Return copy required. Reverse: bread for Mother.
rival_reading: A courier could follow a field-delivery schedule after hours; a receipt due after access ends does not prove officials stranded anyone.
gloss: A courier card makes a transfer receipt due after the access rule has ended.

title: The route ended beyond the gate
body: The map marks the transfer window past the work road. The key ring’s tag says LAST RUN, while the closure line is already signed. A receipt is clipped to the map with no recipient name.
rival_reading: The late route could be an ordinary field delivery or a delayed ledger entry; a key tag and unsigned receipt do not establish a failed evacuation.
gloss: A last-run key points beyond a signed closure while the transfer receipt has no recipient.
